authorization: User authorized paired overnight training and waived preprocessing 5.18ms latency gate for accuracy experiment. No deployment claim.

arms.A: full original decode + original aspect-preserving LANCZOS letterbox
arms.B: same full original decode + original tight_crop.detect_tight_crop + same letterbox; train-only random erasing

paired_design.interpretation: joint crop+erasing package; cannot isolate crop effect
paired_design.historical_reference_note: different decoder/schedule; separately reported; local valid already repeatedly examined so intervals do not undo selection bias
paired_design.checkpoint: last.pt final E2 EMA only, never best.pt
paired_design.validation_policy: existing loop E1/E2 diagnostic logs; no adaptation; final E2 fused comparison only

B_only_random_erasing.location: After the p=0.5 gate: 50% uniform location; 50% uniformly chosen outer 20% content band. One small patch; do not target intensities or detect disease.

tiny.warm_start: FP32 EMA weights; fresh optimizer and paired seed

base.warm_start: FP32 EMA weights; fresh optimizer and paired seed

preprocessing.aspect_ratio: single scale = 768 / max(crop_width,crop_height); deterministic rounding; centered black pad

evaluation.aggregation: FP64 arithmetic mean within Subject_id+Study_id only

bootstrap.unit: patient with all their Studies resampled together; aggregation stays within Study

evaluation.missing_class: undefined AUC reported null with denominator; do not claim 10-class Macro when fewer estimable
evaluation.decision: Report detailed AP-only per-class counts/AUC and paired patient intervals; no automatic promotion or test submission; no post-hoc epoch, weight, augmentation or threshold tuning.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: AP-only Study Macro-AUC B minus A at final E2 with paired patient bootstrap; overall AUC is descriptive, not a veto
evaluation.success_interpretation: AP-only positive difference is a signal; CI entirely above zero supports a consistent local effect; interval crossing zero is inconclusive. No claim of online generalization without separate evidence.
